column1: # National annual electrolyzer demand: scenario lookup for the step totals (per node scope).
# multiplier applies to the totals ALREADY in the model. FEM runs use ONLY the
#   GlobalAmbition column of TYNDP 22 and ONLY the ZBA row of EP2050+ (David 2026-08-11)
#   so ALL multipliers below are expressed against that common base:
#   DEFAULT (neighbours): input/electrolyzer_net_demand.csv GlobalAmbition column.
#     Both tyndp24 rungs divide by the GA-TYNDP22 base (tyndp24_de is therefore a
#     CROSS-family comparison: ENTSO-E's lower 2024 electrolysis path vs the GA22 world).
#   CH00: input/electrolyzer_net_demand_CH.csv ZBA row
# LADDER SOURCES (decision 2026-08-11): the model's own scenario producers only -- TYNDP for
#   neighbours and EP2050+ for CH. Wallinger 2025 serves as validation only (SOURCES.md sec. 4).
# TYNDP-24 multipliers are the CORRECTED extraction: network-connected electrolysis only
#   (FEM has no off-grid assets) and scaled to FEM's 17 modeled EU members by their share of
#   final H2 demand (s ~ 0.89 from the TYNDP-24 demand workbook). 2035 = linear interpolation
#   NT-2030 -> 2040. Multipliers are upper bounds (bias note in SOURCES.md section 4).
# Suggested run combos: central = CH00 ep2050_zba + DEFAULT tyndp22;
#   low = CH00 ep2050_wwb + DEFAULT tyndp24_de; high = CH00 ep2050_zba + DEFAULT tyndp24_ga.
#   CH has no upward rung (one-sided by decision; state as limitation).
# Retire electrolyzer_demand_reduction_coefficient (set 1.0) when the steps go live --
#   otherwise reductions double-count; the low rung covers the old halved 2035 case.
scenario
